proposals.reason: The accepted icon is the generic Bitcoin network logo, not the BtcScan explorer brand mark. The official site serves a distinct standalone vector logo (menu-logo.svg, gradient coin badge) which is proposed as the replacement. The site's header variants (btcscan-light/dark.svg) embed raster <image> data and were rejected as replacement sources.

sourceCandidate.rationale: The accepted SVG is the generic flat Bitcoin network logo (#f7931a circle with white B). The BtcScan brand's own official mark is a distinct tilted-coin badge with a #FCC538→#F7931A gradient. The official standalone vector menu-logo.svg replaces the misattributed network logo; original vector, no text, square-cell suitable.

sources.observation: Homepage of BTCScan explorer; only raster favicon referenced in HTML head; brand assets live in the stylesheet.
Stylesheet references url(img/icons/menu-logo.svg) plus header variants btcscan-light/dark.svg; retrieved menu-logo.svg (60x60 'btc_main', gradient coin emblem) as the standalone site logo.
Header logo variant contains an embedded raster <image> element; rejected as a vector replacement source.
